name: mission-rank-reveal
intent: Rank glyph card slams into the briefing with a frozen overshoot, then a wax stamp impacts and settles at a fixed angle to confirm.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Card and stamp appear already settled at RANK CONFIRMED

acceptance: Rank B card travels 56px down from approachDeg -8 — transform-led, not opacity-only
Stamp approaches at scale 2.4 / -18° (impactMs 180) then settles at -12° (stampSettleMs 120)
Status reaches RANK CONFIRMED only after settleMs 90
Replay clears both data-visible flags and stamp data-phase before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows settled card + stamp immediately
